title: Mercurius Proto Iodide
text:
Mercurius Proto Iodide.

         Iodide of Mercury. (Hg2I2.)



Diphtheritic and throat affections where the cervical and parotid glands
        are enormously swollen; membrane begins on or is < on right side; < by warm drinks,
        and empty swallowing (Lach.). Tongue:   thick, yellow coating at base
        (Kali bi. -   golden yellow   coating at base, Nat. p.;
        dirty or greenish-gray coating at base, Nat. s.); tip and edges red; right side of throat
        and neck most affected. For Hunterian (hard) chancre, secondary symptoms rarely follow if
        given in proper dose; great swelling of inguinal glands, no disposition to suppurate.



 Keynotes  by H.C. Allen
